channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt.

item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
The Cockroach movement founder was released from police custody while its leaders were jailed for violating a protest site ban, indicating continued repression of dissent. In Haryana, two individuals were held for allegedly attacking a bus bound for Srinagar, prompting condemnation from Kashmir leaders and the Mirwaiz, who called for strict legal action. Manipur’s Kamjong district saw renewed violence with a Kuki civilian killed, fifteen houses torched in a suspected militant attack, and a gunfire incident that injured two civilians, including a village chief. These incidents add to the ongoing unrest across Kashmir and Manipur, with 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
